answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Other Transactions Question ID: 155371 Country: India Title: Credit received back in account filling petrol using debit card Question: When we fill petrol using debit card of rupees 500, 1000 cash back of 2-3 rupees comes in account after some days. Will this money amount received in account (in this form) considered as interest? (I do not have any credit card, I have only debit card). Answer ID: 155371 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 126/115/B=2/1439) This amount shall not be termed as interest rather this shall come under reward or hiba (gift); thus it is allowed to accept it and use it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
